targets.query:
runtime = from(bucket: "wcckit")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_app_ucalls" or r._measurement == "wcckit_app_ustat" or r._measurement == "wcckit_app_uflow_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "events_total" or r._field == "entry_events_total" or r._field == "return_events_total" or r._field == "parsed_events_total" or r._field == "unparsed_events_total")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "_measurement", "run_id", "pipeline", "language", "pid", "tool"])

markers = from(bucket: "wcckit")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_run_marker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.phase == "start" or r.phase == "end")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "run_id", "pipeline", "phase"])

starts = markers
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.phase == "start")
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "start_time"})
  |> keep(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline", "start_time"])

ends = markers
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.phase == "end")
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "end_time"})
  |> keep(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline", "end_time"])

spans = join(tables: {start: starts, end: ends}, on: ["run_id", "pipeline"], method: "inner")

runtime_spans = join(tables: {runtime: runtime, spans: spans}, on: ["run_id", "pipeline"], method: "inner")

start_points = runtime_spans
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.start_time, _value: float(v: r._value), _field: r._field, _measurement: r._measurement, run_id: r.run_id, pipeline: r.pipeline, language: r.language, pid: r.pid, tool: r.tool}))

end_points = runtime_spans
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.end_time, _value: float(v: r._value), _field: r._field, _measurement: r._measurement, run_id: r.run_id, pipeline: r.pipeline, language: r.language, pid: r.pid, tool: r.tool}))

union(tables: [start_points, end_points])
  |> group(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline", "_measurement", "_field", "language", "pid", "tool"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Application Runtime Event Counts
panels.description: Application/runtime summary event counts projected onto each run start/end span so they align with BPF I/O, hardware counters, and run markers. The y-axis is event count.

from(bucket: "wcckit")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_pcm_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /(?i)(ipc|cpi|frequency|freq|cycles|instructions|cpu|util)/)
  |> group(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline", "tool", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Hardware CPU Activity
panels.description: CPU hardware-counter activity from AMD uProf or Intel PCM, plotted at collector sample cadence over the selected dashboard time range. AMD hosts typically show ipc/cpi/frequency_ghz; Intel hosts use PCM sensor CPU fields when available.

panels.title: BPF I/O Events
panels.description: Bounded BPF block-I/O summary event counts plotted over the selected dashboard time range.

targets.query:
markers = from(bucket: "wcckit")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_run_marker")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" or r._field == "job_lane")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.phase == "start" or r.phase == "end")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "run_id", "pipeline", "phase", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "run_id", "pipeline", "phase"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, run_id: r.run_id, pipeline: r.pipeline, phase: r.phase, _value: if exists r.job_lane then float(v: r.job_lane) else 1.0, _field: "job_lane"}))

starts = markers
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.phase == "start")
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "start_time"})
  |> keep(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline", "start_time", "_value"])

ends = markers
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.phase == "end")
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "end_time", _value: "end_lane"})
  |> keep(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline", "end_time", "end_lane"])

joined = join(tables: {start: starts, end: ends}, on: ["run_id", "pipeline"], method: "inner")

start_line = joined
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.start_time, _value: r._value, _field: "job_lane", run_id: r.run_id, pipeline: r.pipeline}))

end_line = joined
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.end_time, _value: r.end_lane, _field: "job_lane", run_id: r.run_id, pipeline: r.pipeline}))

union(tables: [start_line, end_line])
  |> group(columns: ["run_id", "pipeline"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Run Start/End Timeline
panels.description: Each run is plotted as two points on a pipeline/job lane joined by a thin horizontal line. The y-axis is only a lane/counter; duration is read from the x-axis distance between start and end.

targets.query: from(bucket: "wcckit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wcckit_collector_status") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "exit_code") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "run_id", "pipeline", "tool", "pid", "vendor"])

panels.title: Collector Exit Status
panels.description: Exit status by collector. Zero means the collector path completed successfully; non-zero indicates unavailable, skipped, or failed collection depending on the tool log.
